01803 dallah {dal-law'}

源自 01802; TWOT - 433c; 陰性集合名詞

欽定本 - poor 5, poorest sort 1, pinning sickness 1, hair 1; 8

1) 毛髮 (#歌 7:5|), 紗頭 (掛在織布機上的經線) (#賽 38:12|)
2) 窮人 (集合名詞, 指無依無靠的百姓)

01803 dallah {dal-law'}

from 01802; TWOT - 433c; n f coll

AV - poor 5, poorest sort 1, pinning sickness 1, hair 1; 8

1) hair, threads, thrum (threads of warp hanging in loom)
2) poor (usually coll of helpless people)
3) (TWOT) poorest, lowest
